title: Vocality threads synthesis and patch plays — Jan 2026
summary: Synthesis of ~120 recent customer threads (Dec 2025 -> Jan 2026) focused on latency regressions under Dedicated, confusion around Private deployment routing, and 3 repeat asks for an embedding-cost estimator. Includes 6 proposed micro-patches (quick experiments) and one mid-sized product spike to validate routing visibility. Goal: propose immediate low-effort mitigations and surface hypotheses for product/eng scoping.
content: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY: Across multiple customers (enterprise and AI-native), the dominant threads are: (1) token-level latency spikes during large-batch workloads on Dedicated pools, (2) unclear behavior when Private routes fall back to hosted variants (customers think data left VPC), and (3) requests for a simple embedding cost estimator to help procurement decisions. Many asks are tactical; we can deliver 2–3 low-effort micro-patches in 2 weeks to reduce noise and placate top accounts.
KEY SIGNALS (clustered):

- Latency/Throughput: 37 threads mention intermittent per-request latency increases when batch sizes cross ~8 requests/compute-slot. Common repro: long-tail sequences + KV cache invalidations after rollouts.

- Private routing/privacy fear: 22 threads contain confusion or alarm when a failure shows a hosted fallback in the console. Customers interpret as 'traffic leaked'. Need clearer messaging and an auditable event trail.
- Cost predictability: 18 asks for offline cost modeling (esp. embeddings and reranking). Simple calculators in Console requested more than API changes.
- Observability UX: frequent asks for per-model per-route token breakdown, not just aggregated. Token attribution is cited as 'missing' for debugging billing spikes.
REPR. CUSTOMER QUOTES (anonymized):
- 'We saw a 5x tail for some requests after the canary — we had to yank the route.'
- 'Why does the console show a fallback model? Our compliance team flagged it as a possible exfiltration.'
- 'We want a 1–2 slide thing we can show finance: how embeddings cost scales with corpus size.'
CLUSTERED ASKS (mapped):
- Observability / Console: per-route token-attribution, fallback audit timeline, explicit 'private only' UI guardrails.
- Serving/runtime: smoother KV cache warm-up, burst isolation for Dedicated slots, a rollback-safe canary for KV-affecting rollouts.
- Pricing/Estimation: simple embedding cost estimator, downloadable tokenized-sample report for invoices, warn-on-high-batch in console.
PRIORITIZATION (impact / effort shorthand):

- Micro-patch A (Impact: high, Effort: S): Console 'fallback' label — change wording + tooltip + email alert for private routes. Rationale: immediate reduction in support escalations. (Est: 3 dev-days + 1 UX change)
- Micro-patch B (Impact: medium, Effort: S): Warn-on-high-batch UI flag when configuring Dedicated pool — prevents accidental high-latency configs. (Est: 2 dev-days)
- Micro-patch C (Impact: medium, Effort: M): Quick KV cache warm-up heuristics toggle for affected model families. (Est: 1 week + a/b test)
- Mid-spike D (Impact: high, Effort: L): Embedding cost estimator MVP in Console (interactive slider, export CSV). (Est: 3 sprints: backend + product + design)
PROPOSED MICRO-PATCHES (detail):

1) Fallback label + audit event (S): change 'fallback' wording to 'compatibility fallback — no data left VPC' + add explicit audit event in Private audit log and a sticky banner on the affected route. Low engineering risk; legal cleared the language draft.

2) Dedicated pool batch warning (S): add a guardrail: when user sets batch size > configured latency SLO threshold, show warning with suggested batch/slot settings. Hook telemetry for 'dismiss' events.

3) Token attribution quick-export (M): small console panel to export last-24h per-route token breakdown. Backend exposes existing traces; UI composes CSV. Helps CSMs and finance teams. Privacy: redact user identifiers.

4) KV cache warm-up experiment (M): add warm-up policy that prefetches KV for canary traffic and replays last-KV page for new slots. Requires runtime flags + config API; run as opt-in for 2 customers first.
5) Incident playbook snippet (S): build a templated response for CS to use when customers report fallback events. Include recommended logs to attach and expected remediation steps.

6) Embeddings quick-guide (L but high leverage): product + docs + a Console mini-tool — scope small MVP: slider for corpus size, model selection, and back-of-envelope monthly spend estimate. Ties to billing export.
IMPLEMENTATION NOTES & RISKS:
- Legal/Compliance review required for any text that explains 'no-data-left-VPC' — draft cleared but must include audit evidence link.
- Runtime changes (KV warm-up) could increase burst costs; put behind feature flag and telemetry. Start with one region and two pilot customers.
- Token export must filter PII; coordinate with privacy team to reuse existing redaction pipeline.
NEXT STEPS (owners):
- CS (Maya) -> prepare Incident playbook and FAQ (due 2026-01-20).
- Eng-Console (Jonas) -> implement fallback label + tooltip + audit event (spike 1d, work 3d). PR link placeholder in artifacts.
- Eng-Serving (Priya) -> spike KV warm-up approach, run benchmark on staging (due 2026-01-28).
- Product (Liam) -> scope Embedding estimator MVP with Finance and Docs (discovery kickoff 2026-01-18).
OPEN QUESTIONS (for product/eng sync):
- What is the acceptable fidelity for the embedding cost estimate (tokens vs byte-size vs semantic cost)?
- How much historical telemetry is safe/cost-effective to expose in the Console export? (24h vs 7d)
- Can Dedicated autoscaler be given a per-tenant burst isolation knob without major infra churn?
APPENDIX: DATA SOURCES & SAMPLE THREAD IDS (anonymized):
- Source: Support threads (Dec 1 2025 — Jan 10 2026) — 120 threads aggregated.
- Representative thread ids: CS-THRD-7192, CS-THRD-7279, CS-THRD-7348 (internal only).
- Benchmarks referenced: internal latency runs Dec 2025 (KV-cache toggles), see CONFLUENCE-12345.
QUICK CS TALKING POINTS (one-pagers):
- 'We hear you: fallback UI is confusing. Short-term: clearer label + audit trail. Medium-term: routing visibility.'
- 'Embeddings: we're building an estimator to help procurement teams — early MVP planned.'

END NOTES: This doc is a working synthesis intended to drive a rapid 2-week micro-patch sprint and a product spike for embedding cost tooling. Feedback welcome — drop notes in slack #cs-synth or amend linked Confluence page.'
